item.title: Reality Fracture Secret Lair Bundle — 2026-10-23
item.description: The first Secret Lair Bundle: 6 Play Boosters, 2 Collector Boosters, 2 of 10 traditional foil Secret Lair promos, 20 foil tower basics and a Spindown, at an official $89.99 MSRP (Wizards). Release is Oct 23, but Wizards said on Oct 19 that it is delayed globally and may arrive shortly after that date. Pre-release retailer listings ran well above MSRP ($159.99–$189.99), so don't overpay: wait for MSRP stock unless you love the Secret Lair mythic art.
